answer_2.quote: Evaluation is carried out using three metrics : Mean Average Precision (MAP@N) evaluates a model's precision by assessing how well it ranks the correct class among the top N predictions. Potential@N measures the likelihood of finding relevant items within the top N results, and Accuracy@N@top_gold_1 assesses how often the first most likely substitution appears within the top N highly probable predictions.
